policy: The exposed surface of a tree is a set of items. A patch is judged on the difference: delta = added + weakened - removed - strengthened. Gate rules are ordered, first match wins. 'If the patch grows the surface, you have lost.'

items.route:<host><path_prefix>: a router on the public entrypoint; flags: no_forward_auth, debug
items.port:<service>:<bind>:<port>: a published port whose bind is not private
items.socket:<service>: a container-runtime socket mounted into a service
items.debugflag:<path>: DEBUG enabled in an environment file
items.secret:<path>#<fingerprint>: a covered secret in the tree (fingerprint only)
